channel.title: Sure Lets & Manage: guides for landlords
channel.description: Plain answers for landlords in England from Sure Lets & Manage.

item.title: How much does a letting agent cost in England in 2026?
item.description: Typical letting agent fees in England for let only, rent collection and full management, the extra charges to look for, and what a fair fee should include.

item.title: How to increase rent lawfully in England in 2026
item.description: The Section 13 procedure for raising rent on a periodic tenancy in England after the Renters' Rights Act, including notice periods, the tribunal and the evidence that supports an increase.

item.title: Rent arrears: what a landlord should do in the first 30 days
item.description: A day by day plan for handling a missed rent payment in England, from the first phone call to the point where a Section 8 notice becomes the right step.

item.title: Section 21 has gone. How landlords regain possession in 2026
item.description: The Section 8 grounds landlords in England now rely on after the abolition of Section 21, the notice periods, the court process and the mistakes that lose cases.

item.title: Should you self-manage your buy-to-let or use a letting agent?
item.description: An honest comparison of self-managing a rental property in England against using a letting agent in 2026, covering time, risk, distance and what the fee actually buys.

item.title: The landlord compliance checklist for England, 2026 edition
item.description: Every certificate, check and registration a private landlord in England needs before and during a tenancy in 2026, including the Renters' Rights Act changes.
